semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GTM provides specialized materials and components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: GTM specializes in producing and supplying electrical insulation materials such as GFRP, heat-resistant boards, and heat-insulating boards for the semiconductor industry. They offer machining services for resin materials and engage in trading to procure raw materials internationally, supporting custom component needs in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Production of GFRP (Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastic)
Supply of heat-resistant and heat-insulating boards
Trading and procurement of raw materials from overseas
